items.title: File Widerspruch against the hedge-cutting order
items.quote: Der Widerspruch muss binnen eines Monats, nachdem Ihnen der Bescheid bekannt gegeben worden ist, schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift beim Landratsamt Beispielkreis, Landratsplatz 2, 83043 Musterau, erhoben werden.
items.computation: Letter is dated Mon 29 Jun 2026 and, being posted by an authority, counts as delivered (bekannt gegeben) on the 4th day after posting, i.e. Fri 3 Jul 2026 (§ 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG). The one-month Widerspruch period (§ 70 Abs. 1 VwGO) starts counting the day after delivery (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB), i.e. from Sat 4 Jul 2026, and ends one month later on Mon 3 Aug 2026 (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB). 3 Aug 2026 is a Monday and not a Bavarian public holiday, so no shift is needed.

items.title: Cut back the hedge to the property line
items.quote: Wir bitten um Erledigung innerhalb von drei Wochen nach Bestandskraft dieses Bescheids.
items.computation: The order becomes final (bestandskräftig) once the one-month Widerspruch period expires unused. That period ends Mon 3 Aug 2026 (see the Widerspruch item), so, assuming no Widerspruch is filed, Bestandskraft occurs from Tue 4 Aug 2026. The three-week compliance period then starts counting the day after that (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB) and ends three weeks later on Tue 25 Aug 2026 (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB), a working day requiring no shift. If a Widerspruch is filed instead, Bestandskraft (and this deadline) is postponed until that remedy is resolved.

warnings: The hedge-cutting deadline (25 Aug 2026) assumes no Widerspruch is filed; filing a Widerspruch would postpone Bestandskraft and thus this deadline until the objection is decided.
The IBAN printed in the letterhead is the office's general account for correspondence purposes only — the letter makes no payment demand, so this IBAN should not be used to send any money.
